text:
Situation: Vasopressin 20 USP units/mL 1 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 161 vials at a 4.4 vial per day use rate, providing 36.7 days on hand. Corvale General holds 185 vials at a 6.3 vial per day use rate, providing 29.3 days on hand. The current label names Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as repackager; its registered plant was last inspected on 2024-09-11 with a VAI classification.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include vasopressin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the next 30 days at both sites. No shortage exists per FDA records. Alternate manufacturers are available but not required for immediate continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current purchasing from Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC — buyer approves.
2. Qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Inc. (plant Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO-9, last inspection VAI 2024-05-17) as first alternate — buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Qualify American Regent, Inc. (plant last inspection VAI 2026-06-18) as second alternate — buyer and P&T committee approve.
4. Monitor daily usage and inventory at both sites weekly — buyer reports to P&T committee.
5. Reassess alternate sourcing if any site falls below 21 days on hand — buyer and P&T committee approve.

Not recommended: Initiate emergency purchases, allocate stock, or change clinical protocols at this time.
